turns.prompt: sample.csv and dpph.csv are CW-EPR spectra (first derivative) recorded back to back at 9.74794 GHz on the same spectrometer. The DPPH standard has g = 2.0036. Use it to calibrate the field axis and report the sample's g-value (g) and the field offset of the spectrometer in mT (field_offset_mT, measured minus true).
